portfolio_risk_summary:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.portfolio_risk_summary(p_portfolio_id uuid, p_annual_risk_free_rate double precision DEFAULT 0.04)
 RETURNS TABLE(portfolio_id uuid, portfolio_valuation numeric, volatility_30d double precision, parametric_var_95 numeric, historical_var_95 numeric, sharpe_ratio double precision, sector_hhi double precision, target_hhi_limit numeric, calculation_date date, historical_observations integer, calculation_status text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
WITH portfolio AS (
    SELECT p.portfolio_id, p.cash_balance, p.target_hhi_limit
    FROM portfolio p WHERE p.portfolio_id = p_portfolio_id
), latest_prices AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (security_id) security_id, trade_date, close_price::numeric AS price
    FROM daily_market_quote ORDER BY security_id, trade_date DESC
), valuation AS (
    SELECT p.portfolio_id, p.cash_balance + COALESCE(SUM(h.quantity::numeric * lp.price), 0) AS value,
           MAX(lp.trade_date) AS as_of_date
    FROM portfolio p
    LEFT JOIN holding h ON h.portfolio_id = p.portfolio_id AND h.quantity > 0
    LEFT JOIN latest_prices lp ON lp.security_id = h.security_id
    GROUP BY p.portfolio_id, p.cash_balance
), history AS (
    SELECT r.trade_date, r.portfolio_return
    FROM daily_portfolio_returns r
    WHERE r.portfolio_id = p_portfolio_id AND r.portfolio_return IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY r.trade_date DESC LIMIT 252
), stats AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*)::integer AS n,
           STDDEV_SAMP(portfolio_return) AS sigma,
           AVG(portfolio_return) AS mean_return,
           PERCENTILE_CONT(0.05) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY portfolio_return) AS p05,
           MAX(trade_date) AS latest_date
    FROM history
), latest_vol AS (
    SELECT STDDEV_SAMP(portfolio_return) AS sigma
    FROM (SELECT portfolio_return FROM daily_portfolio_returns
          WHERE portfolio_id = p_portfolio_id AND portfolio_return IS NOT NULL
          ORDER BY trade_date DESC LIMIT 30) last_30
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 30
), concentration AS (
    SELECT MAX(sector_hhi) AS hhi
    FROM mv_daily_sector_concentration WHERE mv_daily_sector_concentration.portfolio_id = p_portfolio_id
)
SELECT p.portfolio_id,
       v.value,
       lv.sigma,
       CASE WHEN lv.sigma IS NOT NULL THEN 1.645 * lv.sigma * v.value END,
       CASE WHEN s.n = 252 THEN GREATEST(0, -s.p05 * v.value) END,
       CASE WHEN s.n = 252 AND s.sigma > 0
            THEN ((s.mean_return - p_annual_risk_free_rate / 252.0) / s.sigma) * SQRT(252.0) END,
       c.hhi,
       p.target_hhi_limit,
       COALESCE(s.latest_date, v.as_of_date, CURRENT_DATE),
       s.n,
       CASE WHEN s.n < 252 THEN 'insufficient_history_252_required'
            WHEN lv.sigma IS NULL THEN 'insufficient_history_30_required'
            WHEN s.sigma = 0 THEN 'zero_return_volatility'
            ELSE 'ok' END
FROM portfolio p
JOIN valuation v USING (portfolio_id)
CROSS JOIN stats s
LEFT JOIN latest_vol lv ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN concentration c ON TRUE;
$function$
portfolio_risk_summary_v2:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.portfolio_risk_summary_v2(p_portfolio_id uuid, p_annual_risk_free_rate double precision DEFAULT 0.04)
 RETURNS TABLE(portfolio_id uuid, portfolio_valuation numeric, volatility_30d double precision, parametric_var_95 numeric, historical_var_95 numeric, sharpe_ratio double precision, sector_hhi double precision, target_hhi_limit numeric, calculation_date date, historical_observations integer, calculation_status text, cvar_95 numeric, cvar_confidence_level double precision, cvar_horizon_trading_days integer, cvar_return_basis text, cvar_observations integer, cvar_window integer, cvar_data_timestamp date, cvar_status text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
WITH base AS (
    SELECT * FROM portfolio_risk_summary(p_portfolio_id, p_annual_risk_free_rate)
), history AS (
    SELECT r.trade_date, -r.portfolio_return * b.portfolio_valuation AS loss
    FROM daily_portfolio_returns r CROSS JOIN base b
    WHERE r.portfolio_id=p_portfolio_id AND r.portfolio_return IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY r.trade_date DESC LIMIT 252
), threshold AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*)::integer AS n,
           PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY loss) AS loss_threshold,
           MAX(trade_date) AS latest_date
    FROM history
), tail AS (
    SELECT AVG(h.loss) AS mean_tail_loss
    FROM history h CROSS JOIN threshold t
    WHERE h.loss >= t.loss_threshold
)
SELECT b.portfolio_id,b.portfolio_valuation,b.volatility_30d,b.parametric_var_95,
       b.historical_var_95,b.sharpe_ratio,b.sector_hhi,b.target_hhi_limit,
       b.calculation_date,b.historical_observations,b.calculation_status,
       CASE WHEN t.n=252 THEN GREATEST(COALESCE(b.historical_var_95,0),COALESCE(tail.mean_tail_loss,0)) END,
       0.95::double precision,
       1,
       'current_market_value_weights_adjusted_close_daily_returns'::text,
       t.n,252,t.latest_date,
       CASE WHEN t.n<252 THEN 'insufficient_history_252_required'
            ELSE 'ok_inclusive_ties_at_linear_95th_percentile' END
FROM base b CROSS JOIN threshold t CROSS JOIN tail;
$function$
